data.name: Arshia
data.gender_notes: Arshia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arshia is a Persian name derived from the word 'arsh' meaning 'throne'. The name symbolizes the light of the moon illuminating the night sky. In Islamic tradition, the moon is often associated with the night journey of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and the blessings it brings. The name Arshia carries the meaning “Moon light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arshia usually hope their child will grow to embody moon light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine presence and power of Allah in the universe.
data.etymology: Arshia belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arshia total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: عرضیا
in_urdu.meaning: وہ نام جس کا مطلب بلندیاں یا اونچائی ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عرضیا نام عربی جڑ 'عرض' سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے بلند کرنا یا اونچا کرنا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں بلند مقام یا جنت میں بلند مرتبے کی نشاندہی کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس نام کے روحانی معنی بھی ہیں جو فرد کی روحانی ترقی اور اندرونی سکون کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अर्शिया
